correctness.rationale: The Le--Rhaly interrupter gives unshifted \(D_{0,m}=A^*(I-P_m)A\ge0\). Finite coordinate compressions satisfy exact cancellation \(\operatorname{Tr}(E_N D_{0,m}E_N)=\sum_{j\le N,n>N}|A_{nj}|^2\). The large-n scaling \(N A_{nj}\to (m/u)(1-v/u)^{m-1}\), uniform on compact \(u\in[1,R],v\in[0,1]\), yields a double Riemann integral; the remaining tail is O(1/R) uniformly in N. After substitution the limit is \(m^2\int_0^1\int_0^1(1-vw)^{2m-2}dvdw=m^2H_{2m-1}/(2m-1)\). Positivity plus bounded trace of increasing compressions proves actual trace class. For each fixed shift, \(K=M_{\alpha,m}-M_{0,m}\) has entries O(n^-2) per n-th row, whose \(\ell^2\) norms are O(n^-3/2), giving a trace-class row decomposition. All terms in \(D_\alpha-D_0\) are trace class and cancel in trace by cyclicity; Ma's hyponormality iff \(\alpha\ge0\) identifies the trace-norm equality boundary. Independently evaluated the harmonic values m=1:1, m=2:22/9, m=3:411/100, m=4:1452/245; finite flux checks were corroborative and not substituted for the trace-class proof.

value.rationale: An exact, parameter-invariant Schatten-1 trace for a natural two-parameter nonnormal matrix family is a meaningful infinite-dimensional operator invariant. The boundary-flux proof and summable row perturbation explain why the trace survives loss of hyponormality, yielding the precise trace-norm equality phase boundary.
value.risk: Negative-shift trace norm magnitude is left open; the result uses published positivity machinery.

final_claim: For every positive integer \(m\) and real \(\alpha>-1\), the generalized Cesàro matrix \(M_{\alpha,m}\) on \(\ell^2(\mathbb N_0)\) has trace-class self-commutator \(D=M^*M-MM^*\) with \(\operatorname{Tr}D=\frac{m^2}{2m-1}H_{2m-1}\), independent of \(\alpha\), and \(\|D\|_1=\operatorname{Tr}D\) exactly when \(\alpha\ge0\).
limitations: Integer orders m>=1, shift alpha>-1 on complex ℓ²(N0) only.
No exact Schatten-1 norm for -1<alpha<0, only strict excess above trace.
No claim for arbitrary fractional order or unrelated sequence spaces.
